_: S3 lô A (#566): đặc tả sheet hiệu ứng chiêu cho 7 võ hồn + dung hợp Yêu Nguyệt, theo công thức chuẩn S2 (docs/art/ky-nang-cong-thuc.md). `d` gửi PixelLab /v2/vfx (lite); palette hậu kỳ: [viền, tối, chủ, nhấn, sáng] (xếp tăng dần theo độ sáng). Chạy: node tools/assets/skill-vfx/run.mjs --spec lo-a.json --out <nháp> [--only tên,...]
common: Pixel art VFX for an isometric RPG skill, 3/4 top-down view, transparent background, no character, no text, dark outline, limited palette, white-hot core, centered.

cs.theme: Silver sword qi, thin needle-like flying swords with small stars, cold white-blue, colors silver-blue #8fb4ff, pale #cfe3ff, dark #3c4f70, white.

nn.theme: Crescent moon blades, silver with blood-red edge glints, spinning arcs, colors silver #e6e6f0, red #ff5a6a, dark grey #4a4a5e, white.

ck.theme: Golden chains and lock runes, glowing gold sigils, chain links and padlocks, colors gold #e0b04a, light gold #ffe08a, dark bronze #5e4a18, white.

xx.theme: Warm grilled sausage feast, appetizing steam, sparkles, small sausages, colors orange #e8875a, cream #ffd9a0, brown #6a3a22, white.

td.theme: Sacred white jade cauldron, soft jade glow, drifting light motes, colors pale gold jade #f0e0a0, cream #fff6d0, dark olive #6a5a2a, white.

cb.theme: Seven-color glazed crystal pagoda, rainbow prismatic light, crystal shards, colors cyan #7ef0ff, pink #ffd0f0, deep teal #2a6a7a, white.

ph.theme: Jade spear thrusts, thin crisp piercing lines, jade sparks, colors jade teal #7fe0d0, pale mint #c0fff4, dark teal #1f4a48, white.

yn.theme: Fusion of pink fox tails with hearts and silver crescent moon blades with red edge, colors pink #ff9ad5, silver #e6e6f0, dark magenta #7a2a5a, white.

sheets.d: Straight thin silver sword slash across, one clean line with a bright leading edge like a brush stroke, small afterimage, tiny silver sparks and star dots. Compact.
One thin needle-like silver flying sword pointing right with a bright tip, small star glints and a short sparkle trail behind, slightly pulsing. Compact.
Ground ring around the caster: flat isometric seven-pointed star diagram drawn by sword-qi lines from the center, tiny swords orbit the rim, flares then fades. Compact.
Single sharp silver sword slash, longer and brighter than a plain cut, a faint thin second stroke trailing it, silver sparks and star dots. Compact.
Wide sweeping silver sword-qi slash, thin straight bright line with white leading edge, a thin cross-shaped cut flashes at the end, armor-like silver shards fly, fading afterimage. Large, clear.
Ground seven-star sword formation: flat isometric ring with a seven-pointed star of sword-qi lines, seven small swords orbit the rim, a bright pulse sweeps out, sparks. Large, clear pattern.

A thick bold silver flying sword pointing right filling most of the canvas width, wide blade with a bright tip flare, comet tail of star sparkles and several ghost swords behind it, fading. Large, bold.
Sword and wielder unite: targeting mark on the target, then a thin cross-shaped silver cut flashes, silver armor shards burst outward, star sparks. Large, clear.

Ultimate: a mountain-sized sword of blue-grey steel with silver-blue shading and dark outline (white only for edge glints, no solid white fill) raised high, then a vertical white slash splits the scene in two in one frame, ground crack and shockwave, silver sparks rain. Very large, dramatic.

Transformation dive: a giant spectral sword turns tip-down, plunges like an arrow onto the target leaving a silver streak, huge cross cut burst, expanding rings, falling silver shards. Very large, dramatic.
Seven swords plunge into the ground in a ring around the caster, then burst into an expanding ring of sword-qi, flat isometric, silver sparks and star dots. Large.
Dash through enemies: a long crescent-moon streak trails behind a fast motion line, silver with red edge, afterimage fades, tiny red glints. Compact.
Targeting mark appears, then a diagonal silver crescent cut flashes across and red light drops spray out, small silver dust. Compact.
Two crescent-moon blades sweep across one after another, silver with blood-red rims, small afterimage, silver dust and red wisps. Compact.
Targeting mark, then a larger crossing crescent cut with a thin red edge, red light drops burst, silver dust. Compact.
Long crescent-moon dash streak, two curved silver blades trailing with blood-red edges, speed lines, fading afterimage, red glints. Large, clear.
Targeting mark, crescent slash crosses the target, red embers ignite and burn on it, red light drops spray, silver dust. Large, clear.
Two big crescent moons overlap and cross while sweeping forward, silver with crimson rims, bright flash where they cross, fading afterimage. Large, clear.
Rapid chain of crescent cuts on one target from many angles, targeting mark first, red light drops burst, a bright silver flash, lingering red wisps. Large, clear.
Ultimate Blood Moon: silver moon above the target turns deep crimson, splits into many crescent blades that fall and slash in sequence, red flashes, ground ripple of red light. Very large, dramatic.

Transformation: one crescent moon splits into two spinning blades that cross-slash diagonally through the target, then merge back into one bright moon, ripples of silver and red. Very large, dramatic.
Crescent moon blade flashes and streaks across the target in one cut, thin red edge, a sharp silver flash, red light drops, silver dust. Large.
Golden chain links fly in and a glowing padlock rune appears on the target then snaps shut with a flash, gold sparks. Compact.
Ground ring around the caster: flat isometric golden rune circle spins, six chains shoot out from it and lock, gold sparks. Compact.
Golden chains spiral inward on the ground, pulling toward the center, flat isometric rune ring contracts, gold sparks. Compact.
Larger flat isometric golden rune ring, eight chains shoot out to the rim and lock in turn, rune glyphs flare, gold sparks. Compact.
Golden chains wrap around the target, a large padlock rune slams shut with a heavy clunk flash, runes flare, gold sparks. Large, clear.
Golden prison: flat isometric rune circle on the ground, chains rise into a cage shape and lock, rune glyphs pulse, gold sparks. Large, clear pattern.
Golden chains spiral inward pulling everything to the center on a flat isometric rune ring, then a binding sigil flashes and freezes the spot, gold sparks. Large, clear.
Targeting mark, a heavy golden orb smashes the air above the target, cracks like broken glass spread in the air, chains snap outward, bright flash. Large, clear.

Ultimate Heaven-Earth Lock: golden chains drop from the sky and rise from the ground wrapping the target, a layered eight-trigram bagua rune ring seals the wide ground area, a huge glowing padlock closes, flashes white, then shatters into gold shards. Deep layers, dramatic.

Transformation: a giant spectral chain guardian coils golden chains around the whole area, concentric bagua rune rings spin in layers, chains tighten, a large lock snaps shut with a blinding flash and bursts into gold fragments. Deep layers, dramatic.
Quick golden chain ring snaps shut around the caster on the ground, flat isometric, rune flash and chain links flying, gold sparks. Large.
Healing aura around the caster: warm glow ring, small sausage-shaped sparkles and warm steam rising up gently, sparkles. Compact.
Soul-power aura: tiny sausages orbit around the center in a swirl, steam trails, sparkles rising. Compact.
Flying aura: steam puffs like small wings sweep upward with streak lines and a sausage-shaped glint, sparkles. Compact.
Copy aura: a sausage splits into several ghost sausages that fan outward and fade, steam wisps, sparkles. Compact.
Big healing aura: warm glow dome rises around the caster, a ring of sausages and steam rising, soft shield ring, sparkles. Large, clear.
A fat grilled sausage with grill marks flying right and spinning, clear sausage shape filling the middle, crackling electric arcs around it, white steam trail, sparks. Large, bold.
Cleansing aura: warm steam ripples sweep outward in rings from the center, a clear light shimmer, small sausages dancing, sparkles. Large, clear.
Grand copy: sausages multiply in a ring around the center and spin, glowing trails and steam, bright flash at peak, sparkles. Large, clear.
Ultimate feast: a round banquet table of sausages appears around the area, aroma steam rises into a golden column of light, warm halo spreads outward. Very large, dramatic.
Transformation: a giant sausage rises overhead then lowers, spreading a wide golden holy light ring over the area, steam and sparkles pour down. Very large, dramatic.
Gentle warm steam wafts out in a soft ring around the caster, tiny sausage glints and sparkles drifting up, soft glow. Large.
Healing aura: soft white jade light rises around the caster in streams, small jade light motes drift up, gentle glow ring. Compact.
Shield aura: a translucent jade bubble forms around the center, small jade glints on its surface, motes. Compact.
Ground ring around the caster: flat isometric jade halo with three dots at the three feet of a small cauldron mouth tilting at the center, flares and fades. Compact.
Protecting aura: jade glow rises and a thin jade shield ring closes around the center, motes drifting, soft light. Compact.
Ground ring around the caster: a jade cauldron mouth tilts, a wide flat isometric jade halo with three feet dots pulses outward, light motes rise. Large, clear.
Strong healing aura: jade light pillars rise in a circle, a thick jade shield dome shimmers, cleansing light ripples, motes. Large, clear.
A jade cauldron drops onto the ground area and seals it, flat isometric jade halo ring with rune light flashing, evil shadows dissolve, motes. Large, clear.
Holy cauldron: a jade cauldron outline glows above the center and shines a halo of light down, soft rings spreading, motes. Large, clear.
Ultimate: a huge jade cauldron floats above a wide flat isometric area, tips its mouth and pours down jade light like rain, ripples of cleansing light spread on the ground. Very large, dramatic.
Transformation: a giant jade cauldron flips upside down over the center and covers it with a dome of jade light, light rings radiate on the ground, motes. Very large, dramatic.
Soft jade holy light spreads in a gentle halo around the caster, thin ripples, small light motes drifting up. Large.
Power aura: rising chevron arrows of seven-color light around the caster, a small glazed crystal glint, prism sparkles. Compact.
Speed aura: seven-color light streak lines sweep past the center with wind curves, prism sparkles. Compact.
Soul aura: seven small colored orbs orbit the center in a ring, prism glints, soft glow. Compact.
Defense aura: a hexagonal glazed crystal shield forms around the center, rainbow glints on its edges, sparkles. Compact.
Ground ring around the caster: flat isometric seven-color glazed ring spins with a tiny pagoda at the center, bursts into crystal shards outward, prism light. Large, clear.
Mind aura: a glazed crystal eye symbol shines above the center, seven-color rings ripple outward, prism sparkles. Large, clear.
Holy glaze light: broad seven-color light beams rise from the ground around the center and spread into a soft dome, crystal shards, prism sparkles. Large, clear.
Nine treasures chime: nine small glowing orbs align in a ring and resonate with expanding seven-color ripples, bright flash, prism sparkles. Large, clear.
Ultimate: a nine-story glazed pagoda stands overhead, nine beams of seven-color light shoot down and wrap into a glowing invincible sphere, prism ripples spread on the ground. Very large, dramatic.
Transformation: nine stories of a glazed pagoda light up one by one from bottom to top, radiating seven-color rays outward, crystal shards, rings of prism light. Very large, dramatic.
Thin glazed crystal shell forms around the caster and shimmers with seven colors, a soft ring pulse, tiny prism sparkles. Large.
Bold jade spear thrust: one thick bright jade line stabs forward across most of the canvas and ends in a big bright burst at the tip, jade sparks, afterimage. Compact but bold.
Bold spear dash: a thick jade streak across most of the canvas with speed lines and a big bright spear head at the front, afterimage fades, jade sparks. Compact but bold.
Targeting mark, then a round piercing hole bursts with jade sparks, a short red tassel flutters away. Compact.
Long thick jade spear sweep across the whole canvas, bold bright line with a big flare at the end, a faint second line, jade sparks. Compact but bold.
Targeting mark, then several quick piercing hits leave round holes bursting jade rays, red tassels fly, a bright flash. Large, clear.
Large spear-head shaped jade projectile pointing right, thick bold body filling most of the canvas width, red tassel streaming behind, jade spark trail and faint ghost copies. Large, bold.
Wide sweeping jade spear slash with a bright white edge and a flare at the end of the line, jade sparks, fading afterimage. Large, clear.
Long spear dash piercing through a line of enemies like cutting clouds, a straight jade streak with a ring burst at the end, red tassel, sparks. Large, clear.
Ultimate Heaven Spear: a giant spectral spear pierces across the whole scene in one line, many ghost spears follow and stab, a long jade streak mark left on the ground. Very large, dramatic.
Transformation: a spear and its wielder merge into one jade streak that dashes through the target in a straight line, round burst holes, rings and jade sparks follow. Very large, dramatic.
Straight jade spear streak pierces right through the target heart, a ring of jade rays bursts, red tassel flutters, sparks. Large.

Fusion ultimate: three rings of large silver crescent-moon blades with pink edges orbit one after another around the center on the ground, each ring leaves small pink hearts that melt into petals, then a big pink and silver full moon opens. Crescent blades clearly visible. Very large, dramatic.
